title: Login failures after SSO certificate rotation
text: Alpha tenant users could not log in after an SSO certificate rotation. The incident affected SAML validation and produced invalid signature errors.

title: Login failures after SSO certificate rotation
text: The support mitigation rolled back metadata while a new certificate chain was published and validated by the identity provider.

title: Slow search after lexical index rebuild
text: Search latency increased after a lexical index rebuild because segment caches were cold and duplicate token postings expanded the candidate set.

title: Slow search after lexical index rebuild
text: Warmup and compaction reduced p95 latency below the support threshold after the lexical index rebuild incident.

title: Backup restore validation failure
text: A restore drill failed because the backup manifest referenced a missing segment bundle in storage.

title: Backup restore validation failure
text: The operator re-ran backup validation, repaired the manifest, and verified WAL replay before accepting the restored database.

title: Rate limit rejected bulk ingestion
text: Bulk ingestion returned HTTP 429 responses because the data token exceeded its configured rate limit.

title: Rate limit rejected bulk ingestion
text: The fix was to use a dedicated ingestion token and stagger CSV upload batches during support operations.

title: Context pack missing citations
text: A context pack contained relevant cells but lacked citations for two support facts.

title: Context pack missing citations
text: The resolution required source references on ingested cells and enabling the require citations policy for audit mode.

title: Verify fact reported mixed evidence
text: VERIFY FACT returned mixed evidence because one runbook said a patch was deployed while an older incident note said the patch was postponed.

title: Verify fact reported mixed evidence
text: The support team marked the old note superseded and kept both citations for the mixed evidence decision.

title: Tenant scope leak prevented by AgentView
text: A support engineer attempted to query another tenant scope during an incident review.

title: Tenant scope leak prevented by AgentView
text: AgentView runtime filtering prevented private tenant cells from appearing in retrieval results and audit logs recorded the denied scope.

title: CORS allowlist blocked dashboard request
text: The dashboard could not call the API from a staging origin because the CORS allowlist only contained the production hostname.

title: CORS allowlist blocked dashboard request
text: Adding the staging origin fixed browser preflight failures for the dashboard support workflow.

title: WAL recovery stopped at partial tail
text: After a power loss, best-effort recovery stopped at a partial WAL tail and returned a safe truncate offset.

title: WAL recovery stopped at partial tail
text: Strict recovery failed as expected until the operator repaired the partial WAL tail.

title: Vector search fallback kept recall safe
text: Guarded ANN reported a recall risk on a small support corpus and used exact vector fallback.

title: Vector search fallback kept recall safe
text: The fallback increased latency but preserved exact parity and production_safe=true for retrieval.
